name: MIRIX

paper.title: MIRIX: Multi-Agent Memory System for LLM-Based Agents

construction.unit: typed entry (e.g. episodic: event_type, summary, details, actor, timestamp)
construction.kept_as: LLM-written summaries/details; Resource and Knowledge Vault keep verbatim content
construction.processing: Meta Memory Manager routes input to per-type Memory Managers, which write in parallel
construction.writer: multi-agent LLMs (gpt-4.1-mini on LoCoMo; Gemini 2.5 Flash on ScreenshotVQA)

organization.stores: Core, Episodic, Semantic, Procedural, Resource, Knowledge Vault
organization.index: sqlite; embedding, BM25 and string-match search

management.operations: Memory Managers update own store avoiding redundancy; Core rewritten above 90% capacity

retrieval.candidates: top-10 entries from each of the six stores (active retrieval)
retrieval.selection: Chat Agent picks stores and method (embedding_match, bm25_match, string_match)

use.context: source-tagged retrieved memories injected into the system prompt
use.reasoning: Chat Agent runs targeted tool searches, consolidates, then answers

stages.ingestion: New input (text or screenshots) triggers a search over the memory base; input plus retrieved context go to a Meta Memory Manager.
stages.construction: The Meta Memory Manager routes content to per-type Memory Managers that write structured entries (e.g., episodic: event_type/summary/details/actor/timestamp; semantic: name/summary/details/source) in parallel, avoiding redundancy.
stages.organization: Six typed stores: Core (persona + human blocks), Episodic, Semantic, Procedural, Resource, Knowledge Vault (verbatim sensitive values with access control).
stages.update: Memory Managers update their own stores; Core Memory is rewritten when above 90% capacity; the Chat Agent can directly request precise updates.
stages.retrieval: Active Retrieval: the agent generates a topic from context and retrieves the top-10 entries from each of the six stores into the system prompt; the Chat Agent can additionally call embedding_match, bm25_match or string_match on chosen stores.
stages.answer: Chat Agent consolidates retrieved, source-tagged memories and synthesizes the response.

summary: Multi-agent memory with six typed stores (core, episodic, semantic, procedural, resource, knowledge vault) coordinated by a meta memory manager, with topic-based active retrieval.
notes:
AXES-CHECK: consistent with the paper; retrieval is 'topic search per store' (top-10 per store) plus agent-chosen embedding/BM25/string-match tool calls. Some stores keep verbatim content (Resource Memory, Knowledge Vault), so fidelity tagged mixed. No peer-reviewed venue found (arXiv preprint as of 2026-09). Also evaluated on the multimodal ScreenshotVQA (not recorded as it is not a conversational-memory benchmark).
DESIGN: Sec 3.1-3.3, 4.1.2. Corrected prefill: 'meta-manager routing' kept in construction.processing but made concrete; kept_as changed from 'rewritten' because Resource Memory and Knowledge Vault store verbatim content. conflicts/forgetting null: no contradiction handling or deletion policy described (only Core Memory compaction).
